name: io.github.gambrelcolby63/helm-mcp
title: HelmSwap
description: HelmSwap quotes and unsigned swaps. Disclosed 10/50/100 bps fees. Never signs.

environmentVariables.name: HELM_REFERRER
environmentVariables.description: Optional payout address (EVM or Solana). Receives 20 percent of Helm's disclosed fee. Address only, never a key.

environmentVariables.name: HELM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: HelmSwap API origin. Defaults to https://helmswap.com.
